is there real disease hiding inside a vaccine

Nothing in there can give you the illness. 💉 Some vaccines carry a killed germ, some carry a live one weakened until it is harmless, and many carry just one piece, a single protein from the germ's coat. what actually happens before an operation

why can't i see colours properly in a dark room

Your retina carries two kinds of sensor. Cones read colour but need a decent amount of light; rods are far more sensitive yet report no colour at all. In dim light only the rods have enough signal to speak, so the room arrives in shades of grey. Nothing is wrong with your eyes — the colour system has simply run out of light. 👁️ [FACT]Eyes take about half an hour to fully adapt to darkness.[/FACT][CHIPS]Why use red light?|How long to adjust?[/CHIPS]

what exactly happens at an equinox

Twice a year — around 20 March and 22 September — Earth's tilt leans neither toward nor away from the Sun. what is a penrose tiling

how do artists decide where to put things in a picture

why does electricity travel on those huge towers instead of ordinary wires

Wires waste power as heat, and the waste grows with the current, not the voltage. Transformers near your street bring it back down. 🗼 Those lines stay deadly, which is why they hang out of reach. [CHIPS]How do transformers work?|What is voltage?[/CHIPS]

why does tamil nadu get most of its rain in october

Two different monsoons, arriving from opposite directions. The June one blows off the Arabian Sea and empties most of its water on the Kerala side of the Western Ghats, leaving much of Tamil Nadu in the rain shadow. what does a doctor mean when they say alcohol has damaged someones liver

what is actually happening to the particles when water boils

why does one seventh give 142857 that just shuffles around

why do websites not store your actual password

Because a stolen database should not hand over your login. Sites store a hash instead: a one-way scramble that is easy to run forwards and impractical to run backwards. When you sign in they hash what you typed and compare scrambles, never the password itself — which is why a real site can reset your password but can never tell you the old one. 🔐 Good sites pick a deliberately slow hash too, so guessing millions of passwords stays expensive. how did anyone come up with the idea of a vaccine

how does an x-ray photo show my bones

why do people sprinkle salt on icy roads

Salt lowers the temperature at which water freezes. Dissolved salt particles keep getting in the way of water molecules trying to lock into an ice crystal, so the ice needs to be colder than usual to hold together — and at ordinary winter temperatures it melts instead. In a deep enough freeze, though, plain salt stops helping. ❄️

what exactly is colour blindness

Normal colour vision uses three cone types, tuned roughly to red, green and blue light. In the common form one type is missing or shifted, so certain reds and greens send nearly identical signals and become hard to separate. It is usually inherited and more common in boys, because the genes involved sit on the X chromosome. People who have it see sharply — just with a smaller palette. 🎨 [CHIPS]Which jobs need it?|Can it be fixed?[/CHIPS]

how do noise cancelling headphones actually cancel noise

why is tamil so different from hindi

Because they are not related — not distantly, not at all. 🌏 Tamil belongs to the Dravidian family. Hindi belongs to a completely different family, Indo-European, which also holds Persian, Greek and English; inside that family Hindi sits on the Indo-Aryan branch. That is why Hindi's do and English's two turn out to be cousins, while Tamil's irandu is related to neither. Centuries of living side by side means the two swap words freely — but the skeleton underneath is built differently.

why does my voice sound different in a recording
